title: stachys malacophylla
intro: Stachys malacophylla, commonly known as Himalayan stachys or velvet pruner, is a plant species belonging to the Lamiaceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and acting as an expectorant. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to relax muscles, reduce anxiety, and alleviate respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of Stachys malacophylla include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and diterpenes, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
